cfg.autoShowPanel: Open the Agent Office panel automatically when VS Code starts.
cfg.autoSpawnAgent: On startup, launch one agent automatically if none is running.
cfg.hooksEnabled: Use Claude Code hooks for faster, more reliable live detection (asks before adding a hook to ~/.claude/settings.json). When off, only transcript (JSONL) watching is used.
cfg.notifications: Show a VS Code notification when an agent asks for permission (or has been waiting 3+ minutes) while the panel is hidden.
cfg.notifyOnErrors: Also show a notification every time a tool call fails (off by default: failed tool calls are frequent and usually self-corrected; the office still shows the agent in red with the reason).
cfg.statusBar: Show the agent count and who needs your attention in the status bar, even when the office panel is closed.
cmd.pinAgent: Agent Office: Pin Agent to Status Bar…
